description: Proxy subscription collection, verification, and formatting pipeline with Cloudflare Workers deployment

architecture.overview: Pipeline runs on 15-min heartbeat: odd runs dispatch probe-egress (concurrent 5MB downloads); even runs dispatch update-now (fetch upstream → verify → publish), then chain probe-egress. Cloudflare Workers serve subscriptions and manage scheduling. Freshness Watchdog ensures non-stall.

scheduling.run_alternation: Odd runs dispatch 'probe-egress'; even runs dispatch 'update-now' which chains to probe-egress

data_flow: 3. DNS prewarm (32 threads) -> TCP probe -> HTTPS gate -> speed test
4. Country verification via GeoLite2 + ip-api (roaming egress pool)
7. proxy-pipeline-heartbeat CF Worker dispatches workflows every 15 min
8. proxy-egress-ip-check CF Worker verifies egress IPs
9. Freshness Watchdog ensures pipeline doesn't stall

proxy-chain-subscription.purpose: Subscription formatter endpoint. Serves proxy entries in multiple formats. Receives entry64-encoded entries, validates, scores, outputs formatted files.

proxy-egress-ip-check.purpose: Egress IP verification. Downloads payload and streams it back.

proxy-pipeline-heartbeat.purpose: 15-min cron dispatcher. Odd runs dispatch probe-egress; even runs dispatch update-now. Uses KV to persist run counter.

probe-egress.yml.name: Probe proxy egress IPs
probe-egress.yml.probe_interval: every 15 min (odd heartbeat runs + after db updates)

freshness-watchdog.yml.name: Freshness Watchdog
freshness-watchdog.yml.purpose: Dispatches update.yml or probe-egress.yml when freshness thresholds exceeded

tools/.verify.py: 76 KB - TCP/HTTP/Speed gates and proxy scoring

workflow_failure_diagnosis.symptom: Update Proxy Database workflow failing repeatedly
workflow_failure_diagnosis.root_cause: Network connectivity issues (TLS handshake timeouts to api.github.com) causing the Cloudflare heartbeat worker's dispatch calls to fail
workflow_failure_diagnosis.secondary_issue: ip-api metadata assertion fails when TLS timeouts cascade through the egress proxy pool, resulting in 0 successful lookups
workflow_failure_diagnosis.note: Failures are intermittent/operational, not code bugs. The pipeline logic is sound; connectivity to GitHub API is the bottleneck.
